verdict.rationale: Runloop explicitly documents suspend/resume of Devboxes with state preservation ('Suspend and resume: Pause sandboxes to save state and costs, then resume exactly where you left off') and provides a dedicated tutorial workflow demonstrating suspending a devbox to preserve state and resuming to continue work, plus underlying snapshot mechanics that save disk state for later restoration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation that memory (not just filesystem/disk) state is fully preserved across suspend/resume, and explicit detail on process/memory state handling beyond disk snapshots.
